claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k complete and production-ready (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: LangDom≈0.48, JuristPref≈0.73). Linear combinations (equal concat of center_projected_64 + cited_decisions_tfidf) pass both adversarial gates at 19-year scale (122k decisions) with JP≈0.54, LangDom≈0.77, partially breaking the two-mode tradeoff. However, JuristPref ceiling remains at ~0.54 for stable combinations, cross-lingual transfer remains weak (zero_shot_nmi ~0.2), and citation independence is sacrificed (CiteIndep ~0.31 vs 0.505 for metric-learning baseline). Full 174k dense embeddings blocked by source data gap (51,948 decisions missing, parquet missing, bge_↔bger_ ID mapping missing). Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all scales: no single representation dominates all metrics. Product must expose multiple map modes.
evidence_summary: Verified across 10 primary evidence files: (1) 15yr linear_hybrid05_concat (JP=0.473 FAIL, LangDom=0.809 PASS); (2) 15yr linear_citation_concat (JP=0.481 FAIL, LangDom=0.794 PASS); (3) 19yr dense eval (center_projected_64: LangDom=0.860 FAIL, JP=0.369 FAIL; center_projected_128dim: LangDom=0.867 FAIL, JP=0.356 FAIL); (4) 19yr linear combinations (linear_citation_concat PASS: LangDom=0.767, JP=0.545; linear_hybrid05_concat PASS: LangDom=0.778, JP=0.540); (5) 19yr TF-IDF baseline (LangDom=0.472 PASS, JP=0.724 PASS); (6) Section cross-lingual (Sachverhalt cp_64: cross_lang=0.282, gap=0.187; Erwaegungen cp_64: cross_lang=0.094, gap=0.452 — center projection improves both); (7) v8 holdout (4 zero-shot TF-IDF hybrids PASS on true holdout, leakage minimal per prior audit); (8) Dense checkpoints (122,015/173,963 decisions, 19/26 years); (9) v29 final report (synthesis consistent with evidence); (10) Lane state legal-distance.json (BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES, continue_recommended=false). No leakage, gaming, post-hoc metrics, weak baselines, prettiness-as-quality, benchmark gaming, boilerplate confounding, or unsupported product claims detected. Negative results honestly reported.
